function RunCap("'$exe,$arglist,$out,$err){ $p=Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $arglist -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -Wait -PassThru; return $p.ExitCode }
$cases=@(
  @('"'headers','tmp\\sel.csv','tmp\\sel2.csv'),
  @('headers','--intersect','tmp\\sel.csv','tmp\\sel2.csv'),
  @('select','"'!"h[]3"[0]'"','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('select','--no-headers','5-1','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('select','dne','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('slice','--index','1','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('slice','--start','3','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('slice','--start','3','--end','1','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('search','--invert-match','"'^foo'"','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('search','--no-headers','--select','2','"'^b'"','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('sort','-R','--no-headers','tmp\\sort.csv'),
  @('fmt','--crlf','tmp\\fmt.csv'),
  @('fmt','--out-delimiter','h','tmp\\fmt.csv'),
  @('table','--width','4','--pad','1','--condense','3','tmp\\fmt.csv'),
  @('frequency','--limit','0','--select','h1','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('frequency','--no-nulls','--limit','0','--select','h1','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('frequency','--limit','1','--select','h2','--asc','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('frequency','--limit','0','--select','1','--no-headers','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('stats','--nulls','tmp\\stats1.csv'),
  @('stats','--median','tmp\\stats1.csv'),
  @('stats','--mode','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('stats','--cardinality','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('stats','--select','h2','tmp\\freq.csv')
)
"'$fails=0
foreach($c in $cases){
  $name=($c -join '"'_') -replace '["'^A-Za-z0-9]'"','_'
  "'$e1=RunCap $ref $c "tmp'"\\r2_"'$name.out" "tmp'"\\r2_"'$name.err"
  $e2=RunCap '"'.\\executable.cmd' "'$c "tmp'"\\p2_"'$name.out" "tmp'"\\p2_"'$name.err"
  $b1=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\r2_"'$name.out")); $b2=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\p2_"'$name.out"));
  $er1=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\r2_"'$name.err")); $er2=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\p2_"'$name.err"));
  $same=($e1 -eq $e2 -and [Convert]::ToBase64String($b1) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String($b2) -and [Convert]::ToBase64String($er1) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String($er2))
  if($same){ Write-Output "ok $($c -join '"' ')\" } else { "'$fails++; Write-Output "FAIL $($c -join '"' ') exit "'$e1/$e2 len $($b1.Length)/$($b2.Length) err $($er1.Length)/$($er2.Length)"; Write-Output '"'REF OUT:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\r2_"'$name.out"; Write-Output '"'PY OUT:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\p2_"'$name.out"; Write-Output '"'REF ERR:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\r2_"'$name.err"; Write-Output '"'PY ERR:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\p2_"'$name.err" }
}
Write-Output "fails=$fails"'
